description: Election Commission - Declare that A. W. Rodreego as a member of the Minuwangoda PS
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Minuwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is a direct electoral process matter under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
